prompt_en: Vertical intimate documentary medium-close photograph of one explicitly adult original character during a private late-night snack ritual at a small home kitchen window seat under one warm lamp. She has a severe straight bob, oval glasses, and a soft buttoned cardigan. Her baseline is meticulous composure and a private rule of exactly three red-apple slices. Show catching the third fruit slice after it slips past the plate edge, pinched outside the plate before it falls as one pleased mouth corner escapes. The frame must visibly contain two aligned fruit slices, one open crescent gap, a wet skid mark over the chipped rim, and the third slice hanging outside and below it. Her hand lunges sideways beyond the plate rather than descending over it; thumb and index finger pinch only the lower tip of the vertically hanging slice, so this cannot read as deliberate placement. Her tracking eyes widen a fraction while one mouth corner lifts involuntarily before she restores her severe expression. The fresh wet skid mark and still-open gap record the recovery already underway. Her clearly adult face, straight bob, oval glasses, and cardigan remain consistent. Her face, sideways-catching fingers, vertical slice below the rim, open gap, and wet skid mark share one tight focal plane. Warm lamp light and reflected apple color bind her face, hand, and worn plate; 50mm natural perspective, skin texture, one loose hair, creased knit, contact shadows, shallow falloff. Nonsexual private humor, observed rather than posed.
